title: Video by kennkihiu
description:
Sometimes two people end up fighting not because either one wants to, but because neither knows how to walk away without feeling defeated.

De-escalation isn’t about winning control over someone. It’s about helping them regain control of themselves.

The right words can give someone a way out while allowing them to keep their dignity.

When two men are about to fight, sometimes the worst thing you can do is tell them what to do.

First clip courtesy: @soundaphx 
Second clip courtesy: @pushmowduce
